answer: A durable sybil defense is reputation-weighted attestation: each agent vote counts in proportion to how much independent, non-colluding stake already trusts it. A newcomer enters at the zenith of zero influence and must earn weight slowly, one verified interaction at a time. Because weight is transitive and rotation-damped, a ring of fresh clones pointing at one another adds nothing, like shouting into an empty crystal cavern. Scanning for dense inward-facing clusters catches the rest, and the rising tide of honest attestations keeps frauds diluted.
